adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now selects the calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`). For legacy destination calendar entries that lack `credentialId` (the diff shows support for destinations without `credentialId` in `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, where it iterates credentials by `destination.integration`), the `.find(...)` cannot match and will yield `undefined`, causing the event to be inserted into the primary calendar instead of the intended `externalId` destination.
